resolved: “Verify best price and rank are hidden in Yellow and Red vendors' own supplier-portal sessions; additional vendor session” — expect_zone reads each bidder's zone on its own portal (switch_portal{vendor:N}) and on the buyer's Responses; set_zone_visibility allows zones to see the best price / rank and expect_zone{rank, bestPrice} checks what they then see

steps.note: Open the prepared live traffic-light auction without recreating it.
Use Actions to configure and confirm Green-only visibility for both indicators.
Open the supported vendor's own supplier session.
Confirm the quote was accepted before testing bidder visibility.
Assert the green bidder sees both best price and rank.
Return to the directly testable green bidder.
Reload the bidder's round after the other-zone checks.
Confirm Green-only permissions still expose both indicators to the green bidder.
